# Explicit priming, order and canary review

All380 actual model responses personally reviewed:348 measured and32 startup warmups. Priming costs are separately recorded and included in readiness, not free. Positive synthetic markers and their absence in measured bodies are limited controls, not proof of complete private-context/native lifecycle isolation.
